items.headline: Ten new single-family home permits issued on Aldeia Drive
items.summary: San José issued permits for new single-family construction at ten addresses on Aldeia Dr, with declared permit valuations ranging from about $425,000 to $642,000 across different floor plans. One of the permits, for the lot at 5 Aldeia Drive, lists 2 dwelling units in the source data despite being filed under the single-family use type.

items.headline: Palo Alto to add 10 EV parking stalls at 1870 Embarcadero Road
items.summary: A permit was issued for an over-the-counter architectural review to modify the existing parking lot at 1870 Embarcadero Road to accommodate 10 EV charging stalls, with a declared permit valuation of $0.

items.headline: Peery Park Plan Could Add Offices, Housing, Move Water Tower
items.summary: The Planning Commission's October 12 special study session agenda listed a proposed amendment to the Peery Park Specific Plan that would increase office and R&D square footage and residential units, and allow relocation of the Libby Water Tower. The same meeting was set to take public comments on the scope of a Supplemental EIR updating the plan's previously certified 2016 environmental review.
